omittedResponsibilities: Unsupported desktop resource entries are recorded as filtered X entries instead of receiving local replacement commands.
preservedResponsibilities: Loads generated labels, placement context, semantics, shortcuts, and slot identities from the pinned Writer resources.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The resource generator combines pinned menu, toolbar, accelerator and XCU inputs into one typed TypeScript loader for browser command metadata; no single upstream XML file contains this composite.
